name: Chime
description: Two soft sine notes, the second entering under the first and landing a fourth above it, on the tonic — something completed rather than something wanting attention. Both are struck the same way, and now say so: one `adsr` of 12ms rather than the two different fractions it took to mean 12ms at two different lengths. It sits on the bottom rung of the level ladder on purpose: it shares a frame with louder cues and is only the reason to look at them.
offBand: Under the set on purpose. It shares a frame with louder cues — a card arriving alongside whatever caused it — and is only the reason to look at them, so being level with them would make it the notice instead.
